If two threads write-fault on the same hole at the same time
of the race will return to userspace and complete their store
have the loser overwrite their store with zeroes.  Fix this for now by
taking the i_mmap_sem for write instead of read
call to get_block().  Now the loser of the race will see the block has

column2: and will not zero it again.

column1: This severely limits our scalability.  I have ideas for improving it
those can wait for a later patch.
